parameters.help_en: The domain ID. Call `QueryDomainByParam` to obtain it
parameters.name: domain_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform real-time DNS resolution
parameters.name: require_real_time_dns_records

CnameAuthStatus.description_en: The CNAME verification status. Valid values: `0` (Success), `1` (Failure)

CnameConfirmStatus.description_en: Indicates if the CNAME host record has been modified. A value of `1` indicates a change, including reverting to the original value. A value of `0` indicates no change
CnameConfirmStatus.description_zh: 是否改动了CNAME的主机记录，已改动：1（改回原来值也算改动），未改动：0

CreateTime.description_en: The time the domain name was created

DefaultDomain.description_en:
Indicates if this is the default domain name.

This parameter is deprecated and always returns `0` (No)
DefaultDomain.description_zh:
是否为默认域名，

值：0 否（该字段已弃用）

DkimAuthStatus.description_en: The DKIM verification status. Valid values: `0` (Verified), `1` (Not verified)
DkimAuthStatus.description_zh: DKIM 验证标志，用户在dns设置的dkim记录是否已经校验通过, 0:通过， 1:未通过

DkimPublicKey.description_en: The public key for the DKIM record
DkimPublicKey.description_zh: DKIM公钥值，用户需要在dns上设置的dkim记录的value

DkimRR.description_zh: DKIM主机记录，用户需要在dns上设置的dkim记录的key

DkimRsaLength.description_en: The length of the DKIM RSA key, such as `1024` or `2048`
DkimRsaLength.description_zh: DKIM 使用的 RSA 密钥的长度，例如 1024、2048

DmarcAuthStatus.description_en: The DMARC verification status. Valid values: `0` (Verified), `1` (Not verified)
DmarcAuthStatus.description_zh: DMARC 验证标志，用户在dns设置的DMARC记录是否已经校验通过, 0:通过， 1:未通过

DnsDmarc.description_en: The DMARC record value resolved from public DNS
DnsDmarc.description_zh: 通过公网域名解析到的DMARC记录值

DnsMx.description_en: The MX record value resolved from public DNS
DnsMx.description_zh: 通过公网域名解析到的MX记录值

DnsSpf.description_en: The SPF record value resolved from public DNS
DnsSpf.description_zh: 通过公网域名解析到的spf记录值

DnsTxt.description_en: The ownership record value resolved from public DNS
DnsTxt.description_zh: 通过公网域名解析到的所有权记录值

DomainStatus.description_en:
The verification status of the domain name. Valid values:

0: Available. The domain name is verified.

1: Unavailable. The domain name failed verification
DomainStatus.description_zh:
域名状态。说明是否验证成功，取值：

0：可用，已验证通过
1：不可用，验证未通过

DomainType.description_en: The required value for the domain ownership verification record, from the Direct Mail console
DomainType.description_zh: 邮件推送控制台提供的所有权记录

DomainVersion.title_en: 域名版本号，0为旧版本，1为新版本。校验通过需要的配置项不同
DomainVersion.title_zh: 域名版本号，0为旧版本，1为新版本。校验通过需要的配置项不同

HostRecord.description_en: The host record for domain ownership verification

IcpStatus.description_en: The ICP filing status. 1 indicates the filing is complete. 0 indicates no filing is found
IcpStatus.description_zh: 备案状态。1表示已备案，0表示未备案

MxAuthStatus.description_en: The MX verification status. Valid values: `0` (Success), `1` (Failure)

MxRecord.description_en: The MX record value from the Direct Mail console
MxRecord.description_zh: 邮件推送控制台提供的MX记录值

SpfAuthStatus.description_en: The SPF verification status. Valid values: `0` (Success), `1` (Failure)

SpfRecord.description_en: The SPF record value from the Direct Mail console
SpfRecord.description_zh: 邮件推送控制台提供的spf记录值

SpfRecordV2.description_en: The complete SPF record. This parameter replaces `SpfRecord`. You can directly use the value of `SpfRecordV2` without constructing it from the value of `SpfRecord`
SpfRecordV2.description_zh: spf记录，以前spf展示内容需要调用端根据响应中的spfRecord计算得出，新增字段spfRecordV2取代spfRecord， 调用端拿到该字段后可以直接进行展示；

TracefRecord.description_en: The CNAME record value from the Direct Mail console
TracefRecord.description_zh: 邮件推送控制台提供的CNAME记录值
